record.question: Which of the following plays an important role in delaying renal replacement therapy?
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Diet. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 12, printed Q33. Source limitation: No unique primary-supported delay-of-RRT conclusion is established for general water/beverages; fluid intake must be individualized, so all-above is not established. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
